s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of multiple asymptomatic skin nodules with slow progression
salient_findings: Multiple skin-colored nodules over neck, trunk, and upper limbs
Nodules are discrete, firm, and freely mobile
Single firm nodule on the lateral tongue
key_facts: 55-year-old man
Asymptomatic skin nodules for 1 year
Lesions slowly increased in size and number
No systemic complaints
No fever, weight loss, or neurologic symptoms
Eats beef, denies consumption of pork
No passage of tape-like worms in stool
Normal vital signs
Unremarkable general and systemic examinations
No lymphadenopathy
Normal complete blood count and metabolic profile
Nonreactive serologic tests for HIV, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C viruses

shortlist.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple asymptomatic skin nodules and a nodule on the tongue are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Tuberous sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute onset of multiple skin nodules could be related to this condition

shortlist.label: Multiple lipomas
shortlist.why_kept: Discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules are characteristic of lipomas

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Slowly progressive skin nodules could be indicative of this rare tumor

shortlist.label: Fibromatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Asymptomatic skin nodules with slow progression are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Firm, non-tender nodule on the tongue could be a leiomyoma

shortlist.label: Basal cell nevus syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple skin nodules and a family history of similar lesions could suggest this syndrome

shortlist.label: Cylindroma
shortlist.why_kept: Asymptomatic skin nodules with slow progression are characteristic of this condition

raw.rationale: The patient presents with multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules that are discrete, firm, and freely mobile, which is consistent with the characteristics of lipomas. The slow increase in size and number of lesions over time also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
rejected.why: Typically associated with cafe-au-lait spots, neurofibromas, and other systemic features, which are not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Tuberous sclerosis
rejected.why: Usually presents with ash-leaf spots, shagreen patches, and other systemic manifestations, which are not described in the case

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: Typically presents as a single, large, and firm plaque or nodule, which is not consistent with the multiple small nodules in this case

rejected.label: Fibromatosis
rejected.why: Often associated with larger, more aggressive lesions and systemic symptoms, which are not present in this patient

rejected.label: Leiomyoma
rejected.why: Usually presents as a single, painful nodule, which is not consistent with the asymptomatic and multiple nodules in this case

rejected.label: Basal cell nevus syndrome
rejected.why: Typically associated with basal cell carcinomas, jaw cysts, and other systemic features, which are not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Cylindroma
rejected.why: Often presents as a single, large, and firm nodule, which is not consistent with the multiple small nodules in this case
